register.labelZh: CUT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: cut across 可以描述穿過某處走捷徑;cut out 則可以描述車輛突然駛離原有位置。；你可以 cut back on 開支、cut down 數量、cut away 損壞部分,或 cut out 不必要的步驟。；cut somebody in 表示讓某人參與;cut somebody out 和 cut somebody off 則可以表示排除或隔絕。；CUT 片語動詞可以描述切入木材、切穿繩子、把食物切成小塊,以及從紙張剪出圖案。
register.summaryEn: Cut across describes taking a shorter route, while cut out can describe a vehicle suddenly leaving its position. You can cut back on spending, cut down a number, cut away damaged material or cut out an unnecessary step. Cut somebody in means including a person, while cut somebody out and cut somebody off can show exclusion or separation. CUT expressions can describe cutting into wood, cutting through rope, cutting food into pieces and cutting shapes from paper.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放在正確位置。；cut out 有多個不同意思,可以描述車輛突然駛離原位、機器停止運作,或某事物被刪除或剪下。請仔細閱讀整個情境。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. When using him, her, it or them in these expressions, place the word as shown: cut him in cut her off cut it up cut them out Cut out has several different meanings. It can describe a vehicle moving suddenly, a machine stopping, or something being removed. Read the full situation carefully.
